MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub node start [options]

Run the worker-node loop (claim → compute → submit)

Options:
  --concurrency <n>             Set concurrency (persisted to config)
  --types <csv>                 Override configured job types
  --poll <ms>                   Override poll interval (ms) when idle
  --daemon                      Detach and run in the background (logs under
                                ~/.memoriahub/logs)
  --headless                    Container mode: auto-register when no nodeId is
                                stored, and drain WITHOUT deregistering on
                                SIGTERM/SIGINT so the node re-attaches on
                                restart (also implied by MEMORIAHUB_HEADLESS=1)
  --face-provider <compreface>  Set face-detection provider (persisted to
                                config)
  --compreface-url <url>        Set the compreface-core sidecar URL (persisted
                                to config; only used with --face-provider
                                compreface)
  -h, --help                    display help for command
